method.fixture: One piece at zero-based (17,17), empty board, quiet unpromoted moves generated by GameState; make_move_for_search measures clock effect; undo restores state.
method.false_reset_detection: Candidate monotone-coordinate certificates identify suspect baseline resets; a breadth-first search over actual generated quiet moves independently proves a return route for one suspect reset per affected form. Every reported form has such a witness. Counts describe this fixture, not all game positions.
method.graph_test: Independent strongly connected components over a generous quiet-movement envelope (individual multi-step legs and subdivided ray/jump lengths), all 1296 starting squares; offsets obtained from actual movement generator.
method.limits: Fixed piece type without captures/promotions. Conservative progress rule ignores temporary blockers and boundary-only traps; no engine-strength or whole-search speed claim. Historical replay does not predict the moves agents would choose under the corrected rule.
